notes.page_account: This continuing letter page identifies φ(F₁) with p_*j^*(F̃₁), where F̃₁ is obtained by restriction, and rewrites gluing data as F₀, F̃₁ and a morphism p^*F₀ → j^*F̃₁. It recalls that p is a fibration and j an inclusion, with a boundary-inclusion interpretation in the smooth case. It then gives a less attractive but more canonical diagram through ringed T and proposes replacing X₀ by its deformation-retract ambient T.

check_events.outcome: The displayed transformation of the gluing morphism is formally type-consistent under the usual inverse-image/direct-image adjunction. This is only a conditional formal check.

The check does not establish the L2 identification, equivalence under restriction, or any geometric hypotheses.
